meta.timeNote: PowerPyx and KeenGamer put the platinum at about 200 hours; Push Square says up to 300 hours or more. This guide plans on 200 and flags the 100% checklist as the swing factor.

platinum.text: The platinum is Vice Got a Price!, and it follows A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion. The checklist is kinder than it sounds: about 60% of true completion. Most collectibles are only partly required, but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need everything. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of the 18 card sets and 300 of the 397 stunts. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything is still doable in free roam after the story. The one thing the checklist cannot fix is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation — do that one during Chapter 1 and the rest of the run is safe.
platinum.title: 100% and the platinum

stages.blurb: Play Chapters 1 to 5 at your own pace. Scan vehicles and study animals as you travel, do optional missions as they appear, and keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter.
stages.priority: Do the Chapter 1 meditation first. Everything else can wait.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.blurb: Finish the five side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), Bret's hunting strand, and the two partner trophies. From Coffee Break onward Jason and Lucia can roam together.
stages.priority: Start every strand the chapter it opens. All of them stay open after the story.
stages.title: Side strands and partner play

stages.blurb: Work the robbery set: gang operations, bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, the showroom job and the money trophies. Vaults pay up to $205,000 each and fund the garages.
stages.priority: Bank vaults first — they pay for everything else.
stages.title: Robberies and money

stages.blurb: Sweep the collectibles: card sets, WAiNK scans, challenges, the bowling job, the scooter app and the three still-unconfirmed trophies. Check the guides again before grinding the unconfirmed ones.
stages.priority: Cards and WAiNK scans are the long tail — do them in sweeps, not one by one.
stages.title: Collectibles and open-world cleanup

stages.blurb: Finish the activity set — stunts, shooting ranges, drone races, the 20 race wins, the stranger strands and the combat trophies — then close out the 100% checklist and take the platinum.
stages.priority: The 100% checklist is the boss. Everything else here is its side quest.
stages.title: Activities, races and the 100% grind
